name: Pulse Run
description: A neon auto-runner where jump timing, sliding, and route memory carry six escalating stages to the reactor core.
market_notes: Mobile auto-runners have broad one-thumb reach; precision timing, three-star replay, and short stages support retention. Neon presentation and low-friction controls offer trailer-friendly moments, while the lane is crowded.
readiness_notes: Playable canvas loop, six hand-authored stages with progression-gated stage select, persistent stage unlocks, touch and keyboard controls with variable jump height, 120ms jump buffering and 100ms coyote time, touch-safe pause HUD and pointer-cancel-safe slide control, first-run control onboarding, exact-position next-hazard and uncollected-core cue with FAR/READY/NOW urgency bands, visual accessible stage-progress meter, live saved-PB pace cue, change-only screen-reader announcements for hazard action/urgency and PB pace transitions, cause-specific death retry coaching, local jump/core/clearance particle feedback, successful-clearance cue with optional local tone and haptic, shared optional WebAudio plus Capacitor/fallback haptics for jump/core/death/clear events, pause/resume, visibility-change auto-pause, exact pause recap with stage/progress/timer/core/checkpoint context, checkpoint-only pause retry action, 50% checkpoint retry, persistent mid-stage resume with validated and corruption-safe menu recovery, malformed-save-safe local progression parsing, explicit pause-menu abandon cleanup, safe-area touch-scrolling stage select/pause/result panels, local stars, per-stage speedrun PBs, live timer, generated par targets, stage-select next-mastery summary, six district PNG backdrops and local PNG runner/hazard/core/ground art with owner-art priority plus generated fallbacks, regeneration script, HTTP(S) cache-first service worker with direct-file fallback, mobile viewport, Capacitor config. Missing: richer audio, native ads, human balance pass, device QA, store publishing integration.

changelog.summary: Stages 1-6 now each hold 3 cores (were 1/1/0/0/0 on 3-6, so 3 stars was unreachable); cores sit at hazard apex for skill-timed jumps. Tests + bot pass.

Added stages 7-10 (Ghost Wire, Static Storm, Zero Hour, Singularity): speed 420-530, 0.25-0.30s min hazard gaps, dense mixed combos. scripts/bot.js exhaustive-search bot proves all 10 stages clearable and monotonically harder; wired into test.js.

Required vertical airborne contact for pulse-core collection: grounded overlap and short hops no longer award stars; added pure coreHit helper, runtime wiring, and regression coverage for miss/collect cases.

Fixed shared readArray scope used by stage mastery and PB HUD callbacks, preventing recurring ReferenceError after boot; wired six-frame grounded runner animation; added regression checks for save recovery, progression, resume wiring, and frame selection.

Added coherent local PNG art pack and SVG regeneration source: six district backdrops, runner poses, ground, gap, barriers, pulse core, controls, checkpoint, reactor, icon, splash, and store feature; runtime prioritizes owner art with generated fallbacks and caches gameplay art offline.
Created six-stage mobile precision auto-runner with jump/slide controls, stars, stage select, local progression, and pure collision/progression helpers.
Added pause/resume controls and 50% checkpoint retry flow, preserving stage timing and collected cores; syntax and checkpoint logic checks pass.
Added live run timers, per-stage speedrun PBs, generated par targets, clear-time comparison, and stage-select PB display; syntax, pure mastery, and difficulty checks pass.
Added persistent mid-stage resume: pause/browser-exit saves stage position, timer, cores, and checkpoint; menu validates and restores saved runs; terminal outcomes clear stale saves.
Added accessible stage-clear mastery recap with missing-core goal, exact PAR/PB chase, next-stage PAR, and final 3-star guidance; pure helper and syntax checks pass; readiness 59->62.
Added 120ms jump buffering and 100ms coyote time for forgiving touch timing; pure jump-assist, syntax, and six-stage difficulty checks pass; readiness 62->65.
Added live next-hazard HUD cue with pure action/distance helper; verified jump/slide/core mapping, syntax, and six-stage structure; readiness 65->68.
Added cause-specific death retry coaching for gaps, low barriers, and high barriers; pure helper, syntax, and six-stage difficulty checks pass; readiness 68->71.
Added shared optional WebAudio and Capacitor/fallback haptic feedback for jump, core, death, and stage-clear events; syntax and fallback checks pass; readiness 71->74.
Gated stage select to cleared content plus next stage, with locked labels and direct-start/resume guards; pure unlock, syntax, and difficulty checks pass; readiness 74->76.
Fixed mobile HUD pause hit area and pointer-interrupted slide state; syntax and focused touch-wiring checks pass; readiness 77->78.
Fixed progression persistence and upgraded next-action HUD to exact-position uncollected-core guidance; pure cue, syntax, and wiring checks pass; readiness 79->81.
Added FAR/READY/NOW urgency bands to exact next-action HUD cues, with pure threshold checks and syntax validation; readiness 81->82.
Added variable jump height: held touch/keyboard input preserves full jump, release creates short hop, and cancel paths clear held state; syntax validation pass; readiness 82->84.
Added short-lived local canvas particle bursts for jump launches and pulse-core pickups; no gameplay or asset-loading changes; readiness 84->85.
Added first-run control onboarding for jump, slide, and variable jump height; input dismisses prompt and local flag prevents repeat; readiness 85->86.
Added visibility-change auto-pause so mobile app switching saves active runs before elapsed time advances; existing resume flow restored on return; readiness 86->87.
Added exact pause recap for stage, progress, elapsed time, collected cores, checkpoint readiness, and saved state; pure helper and syntax checks pass; readiness 87->88.
Added visual accessible stage-progress meter synchronized to exact run distance; syntax, wiring, and six-stage difficulty checks pass; readiness 88->89.
Added live saved-PB pace cue showing ahead/behind/tied status during replay; pure helper, syntax, and six-stage difficulty checks pass; readiness 89->90.

Added successful hazard-clearance feedback: CLEAN JUMP/CLEAN SLIDE cue, local tone/haptic, and pink particle burst after safe passes; collision physics unchanged; syntax, pure-helper, and six-stage difficulty checks pass; readiness 90->91.

Hardened pulseStars and pulseTimes browser-save parsing: malformed JSON and non-array values now fall back safely without boot or HUD crashes; syntax, save-recovery, pure-logic, and entry checks pass; readiness 91->92.

Hardened pulseResume parsing: invalid stage, position, timer, checkpoint, and collection fields now reject or normalize safely; syntax, corruption-recovery, pure-logic, and entry checks pass; readiness 92->93.

Made stage select, pause, and result panels safe-area padded and touch-scrollable so short portrait screens keep stage buttons and retry/menu actions reachable; syntax, responsive wiring, JSON, and entry checks pass; readiness 94->95.

Fixed valid Pulse Run resume saves being rejected by a malformed normalized vertical-position return; saved runs now restore position, timing, stars, and checkpoint safely; syntax and resume normalization checks pass; readiness 96->97.

Added HTTP(S)-only cache-first service worker for local offline relaunch, precaching Pulse Run shell assets while preserving direct file opening; syntax, metadata, entry, and cache coverage checks pass; readiness 97->98.

Made hazard and PB-pace screen-reader announcements change-only via separate polite live regions; exact visual HUD updates remain continuous; syntax, metadata, entry, and accessibility wiring checks pass; readiness 98->99.
Integrated owner PNGs: mid-ground skyline parallax, jump/slide touch button art, burst sprite on pickups/clears; sw cache bumped.
New WebAudio engine: reverb, designed SFX, adaptive procedural music (tempo/layers scale with stage speed, pauses with game).
Death juice: runner-hit pose, screen shake (reduced-motion aware), pink flash, burst, 0.55s beat before result panel.

Stages 11-14 (Overclock, Meltdown, Event Horizon, Pulse Zero; speed 565-690, min gap 0.21s) generated by scripts/gen_stages.js, bot-verified clearable, difficulty 49->60 monotonic; tests + smoke pass.
App icons (192/512/maskable/180/favicon) + Capacitor resources derived from owner icon/splash via art/make_icons.py; manifest icons, favicon links, sw cache v4.
Settings panel (sound FX / music / vibration toggles, persisted); sw v5.
Endless mode (unlocks after stage 3): procedural hazards, speed 300->620 and gaps 0.62s->0.30s ramp, score/best, bot-verified generator (scripts/endless_check.js, 72/72 clearable); sw v6.
